cards.description: 86 year old World’s biggest peace-loving and spiritual organization – Bharma Kumaris; honoured NGO Tammana, its Founder Ms Isha Kakaria & other present members of the team, for the immense social work done during the first wave of Corona.

NGO TAMMANA was honored by the MUNICIPAL CORPORATION, MOHALI for the profound dedication, contribution and humanitarian services extended towards the society through its KARONA Initiative during COVID-19 Pandemic.
NGO TAMMANA was honoured by Municipal Corporation, Zirakpur at the Independence Day 2019 for its contributions towards the development of the children of the Government School, Singhpura, Punjab.
Founder Isha Kakaria gets awarded at ‘Wah Womania’ Award Function by 94.3 My FM Chandigarh on the occasion of Women’s Day’18 (08th March 2018)
Women’s Day Award’18 to Founder – Isha Kakaria by IEC University, Himachal Pradhesh.
#NGOTammana honoured by Sh. Tathagata Roy , Hon’ble Governor, Tripura in a Convocation Ceremony by Aryan Group of Colleges.
Woman Achiever’ Award by Public Relation Council of India (PRCI) to the Founder-President by Sh. Pawan Kumar Bansal
Independence Day Commendation (State Award 2011) to the Founder-President of NGO TAMMANA by Shivraj Patil, Punjab Governor.
Honour by ‘Jyotirgamay’ a Punjab University radio to founder Isha Kakaria in their ‘Hamari Beti’ programme.
Honour by ‘Aryans College’ to NGO Tammana for its contribution towards society.
Honour by Punjab University to NGO Tammana for participating in the women’s Self Defence programme.
Awarded by GMCH -16 Chandigarh for contribution towards blood donation
Only YOUTH ORGANISATION to be awarded at Seva Bharti’s Award Ceremony by Hon. Mr. K.N Pathak, Retd. V.C, P.U ,Chandigarh

highlights: Tammana raised Rs. 3,82,811 during the pandemic and helped 1545 families by providing door to door ration and other basic essentials to all at 35 various locations of deep villages with the help of 100 different donors. 1008 garbage collectors and sanitization workers were given safety kits & 500 sanitary kits were also distributed to women.
Awarded by Aryan’s Group of Colleges in their prestigious award function for consecutively two years ( 2014 & 2015 )
A special feature on Founder President Isha Kakaria , Tammana’s start up and its working ; has been published under ‘Humans of Punjab’ in the March’2016 Edition, La Blend Magazine.
35 children from AIE (Sarv Sikhsha Abhiyaan) 2010-2011 admitted as regular students in 2011-2012.
The Founder President ‘Isha Kakaria’ was also been listed under the City’s Celebrity List(June 2012) by ‘India Today’ Magazine.
Appreciated by Traffic Police for participating high in 21st National Road Safety Week 2010.

Jhuggis of Sector 25 slum, Chd were exclusively adopted individually by members where employment for the ladies were generated, parents sent their children to continue studies who had discontinued in the past.
High success rate of Live Blood & Platelet Donations 24*7, 365 days upon requirement.
Founder President has also been awarded by PU Radio “Jyotirgamaya- Padho aur Padao 91.2Mz” and featured twice with them as & for ‘Humari Beti’ Programme.
Founder President also has been featured via a detailed Interview in ‘Udaari‘ – a Women Empowerment Programme on ETC Punjabi.
‘India Today’ published the works of the Founder President ‘Isha Kakaria’ as the‘YOUNG ACHIEVER of Punjab’.
Besides being interviewed on Day & Night Channel, PTC, PBN News, and more; the Founder-President has also been interviewing on National Channels like ABN News.
In its very first year, it succeeded to send all 220 residing children of Janata Colony (its adopted slum at Naya Gaon) to school.
Alone started with Eye-Donation Awareness Camps in the city, in association with Eye Bank, P.G.I., Chandigarh.
51000/- raised via a tremendous team effort at run against drugs – a fundraiser at Big FM Chd Marathon.
